newsitem.title: UK: British Gas up after positive broker comment.
newsitem.headline: British Gas up after positive broker comment.

text.p: Shares in British Gas Plc edged higher on Friday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
The shares were up 3-1/2p at 189 by 1014 GMT in active trade of almost five million shares -- making it the second most active stock in the FTSE 100 index.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.

Shares in British Gas came under pressure earlier this month, after the company rejected price control proposals from industry regulator Ofgas for its transmission business TransCo -- promting a Monopolies and Mergers Commission inquiry.

Yet the stock has staged a modest recovery, since closing at a near year's low of 180-1/2p on October 7. Earlier this week, SBC Warburg repeated a "buy" recommendation and set a short-term price target of 210p for the stock.
